<solution_file path="src/solution.py">
import pandas as pd
import csv

# Read input file
df = pd.read_csv('outputs/t11_city_indicator_matrix.csv')

# Identify indicator columns (exclude city_id, city_name, year)
indicators = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['city_id', 'city_name', 'year']]

# Calculate missingness per indicator
missing_counts = df[indicators].isna().sum()
total_rows = df.shape[0]
missing_rates = missing_counts / total_rows

# Build missingness report
report_data = []
for indicator in indicators:
    missing_count = int(missing_counts[indicator])
    missing_rate = float(missing_rates[indicator])
    kept = missing_rate <= 0.30
    report_data.append([indicator, missing_count, missing_rate, kept])

report_df = pd.DataFrame(report_data, columns=['indicator', 'missing_count', 'missing_rate', 'kept'])
report_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_missingness_report.csv', index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_ALL)

# Select kept indicators
kept_indicators = [indicator for indicator in indicators if missing_rates[indicator] <= 0.30]
selected_df = df[['city_id', 'city_name', 'year'] + kept_indicators]
selected_df.to_csv('outputs/t12_selected_matrix.csv', index=False, quoting=csv.QUOTE_ALL)
</solution_file>
